expectations.name: capture-does-not-interrupt
expected_behavior: Captures a light draft — `report_gap` with `draft: true`, carrying `detail`, `srd_ref`, and the `search_terms` from the failed lookups — and returns at once
Runs no grill and makes no `submit_gap` call at capture time
Prompts the user for nothing at capture time: the caller's pass continues uninterrupted, and only the end-of-pass offer asks anything

expectations.name: drain-grill-confirm-file
expected_behavior: Surfaces the count and the topics, and offers to work them now
Per gap asks light or heavy, assembles the record, and shows it
Files via `submit_gap` only on the finder's yes and records the gap's `gap-NNNN`

expectations.name: an-srd-gap-is-refused
expected_behavior: Captures the Retention Sweep item as a draft: the platform documentation is what falls short
Refuses the GR-7/GR-9 contradiction — neither captured nor filed — because the SRD is what is wrong, not the docs
Tells the caller to keep the SRD defect in its own findings
Splits the pair rather than taking or refusing both together

expectations.name: opt-out-and-duplicate-merge
expected_behavior: Merges into the existing draft with `update_gap` rather than capturing a twin: `search_terms` are unioned, the existing `detail`, `kind`, and pointer fields survive, and the pointer-less second capture blanks nothing
Takes only the one-line `detail` and leaves `target_claim` empty, honouring the opt-out
Still shows the record for confirmation before filing: opting out of the grill is not opting out of the confirmation

expectations.name: gate-stops-without-the-server
expected_behavior: Stops before any other work, saying no `mcp__srd-doc__*` tools are in the session
Tells the user to start the `srd-doc` server and run `/mcp` to connect, then re-run
Falls back to nothing — no REST call, no local checkout, no gap kept anywhere else
No preamble; each fact stated once

expectations.name: declined-at-the-confirm-gate
expected_behavior: Files nothing
Says the record was discarded (`discard_gap`), so the finder is not left wondering where it went
Offers the amend path before the gate, not after: a correction adjusts and re-shows, a no discards
Names the dropped topic in its reply, so the finder can tell the same weak lookup not to re-capture it

expectations.name: missing-config-stops-the-run
expected_behavior: Stops before any other work, naming the missing `project-config.md` and the directory the search started from
Grills nobody, captures nothing, and calls no gap tool
Guesses no server name or path to carry on with

expectations.name: heavy-grill-and-session-opt-out
expected_behavior: Runs a full `craft:grill-me` extraction for the first gap, rather than a deeper version of the light questions
Honours the opt-out for the remaining two without re-asking the depth question for each
Still shows each record for confirmation before filing — opting out of the grill is not opting out of the confirmation
Takes only the one-line `detail` for the opted-out gaps, leaving `target_claim` empty

expectations.name: drafts-survive-a-new-session
expected_behavior: Finds the draft with `list_gaps` (`status: draft`, `srd_ref` `specs/gateway.md`) and reads no local file for it
Offers to work it rather than capturing it again
Writes nothing outside the server: no buffer file, nothing under `$HOME/.agent-data`
